Bayesian optimization of eta for BRIER.S

BRIERs.bopt.Rd

Tunes the integration weight eta for BRIERs with sequential model-based optimization instead of an exhaustive grid. Each proposed eta triggers one summary-level fit over the full lambda path, scored with the same criterion BRIERs.selection would apply.

Usage

BRIERs.bopt(
  sumstats,
  XtX,
  family = c("gaussian", "binomial", "poisson"),
  beta.external = rep(0, nrow(sumstats)),
  multi.method = c("ind", "PCA", "stacking"),
  optim.args = list(),
  criteria = c("Cp", "GIC", "pseu.val", "gaussian.mspe", "gaussian.rsq", "binomial.dev",
    "binomial.mcfrsq", "binomial.tjursq", "binomial.auc", "poisson.dev"),
  X.val = NULL,
  y.val = NULL,
  XtX.val = NULL,
  sumstats.val = NULL,
  TN = NULL,
  h2 = NULL,
  bounds = NULL,
  init.grid = NULL,
  init.points = 10L,
  n.iter = 15L,
  acq = "ucb",
  kappa = 2.576,
  acq.eps = 0,
  kernel = list(type = "exponential", power = 2),
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

sumstats

A data.frame of target summary statistics containing a corr column.

XtX

A p x p sparse LD matrix aligned to sumstats.

family

A string: "gaussian", "binomial", or "poisson".

beta.external

A p x M matrix of external coefficients, with no intercept row.

multi.method

External aggregation strategy: "ind", "PCA", or "stacking".

optim.args

A list of control arguments for the stacking optimizer.

criteria

Selection criterion, as in BRIERs.selection. Summary criteria are "Cp", "GIC" (need TN) and "pseu.val"; validation criteria require X.val and y.val.

X.val, y.val

Held-out validation data, required for validation criteria. X.val must already be standardized, and y.val must also be standardized when family = "gaussian", because BRIER.S returns standardized coefficients and nothing is standardized internally.

XtX.val, sumstats.val

Optional held-out LD matrix and summary statistics used by "pseu.val". Default to the fitting XtX and sumstats.

TN

Training cohort sample size, required for "Cp" and "GIC".

h2

Optional heritability estimate for "Cp" and "GIC". Defaults to 0.

bounds

A named list of length-2 numeric vectors giving the search box for each eta. Defaults to c(0, 10) per external model.

init.grid

Optional initial design, as in BRIERi.bopt.

init.points

Number of random initial points when init.grid is not supplied.

n.iter

Number of sequential optimization steps after initialization.

acq

Acquisition function: "ucb", "ei", or "poi".

kappa

Exploration parameter for "ucb".

acq.eps

Exploration parameter for "ei" and "poi".

kernel

Gaussian-process kernel specification.

verbose

Logical. Print optimizer progress.

...

Further arguments passed to BRIERs.eta.

Value

An object of class c("BRIER.bopt", "BRIER.selection", "BRIER"), shaped exactly like a BRIERs.selection result with an added bopt element recording the search.

See also

BRIERs, BRIERs.selection, BRIERi.bopt, BRIERfull.bopt

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sel <- BRIERs.bopt(
  sumstats, ld$XtX,
  family        = "gaussian",
  beta.external = beta.external,
  criteria      = "gaussian.mspe",
  X.val         = standardize_X(X.val)[[1]],
  y.val         = standardize_X(as.matrix(y.val))[[1]],
  init.points   = 10,
  n.iter        = 15
)
} # }
